title: Speak Like a Person, Log Like a Protocol
idiom: art-deco linocut, warm voice outside, exact code inside the wire
hero_prompt: Art-deco linocut poster in black, cream and teal, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible carved ink texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: a man speaking warmly into the receiver of an old black desk telephone, his voice leaving it as a soft flowing ribbon of curving lines; the telephone's long cable runs down and across the bottom of the picture, and a section of it is cut open to show a precise straight row of dots and dashes marching inside it in single file. Soft curves outside, exact marks within.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a teal ground, no shading or gradients: one soft wavy ribbon above a straight row of dots and dashes, the two running in parallel. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
